template: Create a production desktop pet PNG sprite sheet, TRUE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND. EXACTLY4columns x10rows=40 isolated complete whole-penguin poses, ordered left-to-right then top-to-bottom. No text labels, panels, grid, floor, shadows, sparks, duplicate animals or detached props. Every cell contains exactly ONE same cute penguin, complete uncropped beak/flippers/feet, broad transparent gutters. Detailed adorable softly shaded pixel-art at desktop mascot scale, rounded expressive face, clean outline, compact baby-like proportions with adult species markings. Same identity, anatomical proportions, fur/feather colors and apparent body size across all poses. Mostly RIGHT-FACING side/three-quarter view, consistent camera. Whole body drawn together, never paste fixed torso above separate legs; wings are short flippers, no human arms/hands. Exact rows: row1=4 idle gentle breathing/blink poses; rows2 AND3=8 consecutive phases of ONE natural forward two-footed waddling walk loop (left support, right foot low swing, double support, right support, left foot low swing, double support; torso rolls mildly with weight transfer, pelvis and feet connected, short steps, near/far feet visible, planted foot drifts backward under body, no moonwalk, no detached limbs); row4=4 quiet beak-open greeting poses; row5=4 species activity poses as described; row6=4 playful horizontal swimming poses with flippers stroking and head facingright, NO surrounding water; row7=4 species special display poses as described; row8=4 sleeping poses with eyes CLOSED, beak tucked naturally toward shoulder, relaxed stable upright or crouched body, same orientation and body size, not dead/flat/faceless; row9=4 carried poses upright penguin balances with two feet together just above baseline, relaxed flippers, no person/hand/rope; row10=4 landing settle poses from small crouch back to upright. Keep 40 silhouettes disconnected by real alpha transparency. Any egg/rock/burrow must be tiny, adjacent to penguin, touching main silhouette so grouped as single cell. No scenery. All ten rows same body scale; swimming and crouching must not miniaturize head.

species.emperor: EMPEROR PENGUIN adult with charcoal black head, soft yellow-orange ear patches fading to pale yellow throat, white belly, dark back, dark bill with orange lower stripe, black feet. Cute rounded tall pear-shaped torso. Row5 activity is belly tobogganing on ice. Row7 special: protect one small egg balanced ON TOP OF BOTH FEET under warm belly fold, NOT holding it with human hands.
species.adelie: ADELIE PENGUIN adult with jet black head and back, stark white round eye rings, short dark red-black bill mostly feathered, pure white belly, pink feet. Cute rounded short body. Row5 activity is short belly slide. Row7 special: pick up and offer a single small nesting pebble WITH BEAK, no hands.
species.gentoo: GENTOO PENGUIN adult with broad white bonnet stripe over top of head connecting above both eyes, bright orange-red bill, black head/back, white belly, orange feet, short brush tail. Cute rounded body. Row5 activity short belly slide. Row7 special: cheerful flipper-stretch and head bow while standing beside a tiny pebble nest, all props in same silhouette.
species.rockhopper: SOUTHERN ROCKHOPPER PENGUIN with thin bright yellow eyebrow crest streamers swept backward from each eye, dark spiky crown, reddish eyes and orange-red short bill, black back and white belly, pink feet. Cute small compact body, NOT macaroni penguin orange central forehead plume. Row5 activity: small two-footed hop over a very low rock and settle, not belly sliding. Row7 special: crest bob and energetic tiny bow, feet remain grounded.
species.little: LITTLE BLUE PENGUIN with slate blue head, back and short flippers, white belly and cheek underside, dark tiny pointed bill, blue-gray eyes, pale pink feet. Extra small stocky cute compact body, no yellow crest. Row5 activity: gently preen chest feathers using beak and flippers close to body. Row7 special: peek around entrance of a tiny coastal burrow then nod, no night sky or large background.
